global: Vertical explainer Short in a lecture-board frame: a stick-figure presenter beside a blackboard (off-white canvas, black line art), cutting to full-frame vignettes: three robed travellers on a horizon, a grey map/globe with red route lines, a planetarium-software screen, and a black night sky with white line art and grey glow plates; red is used only for paths, arrows, scribble strikes and hand-lettered corrections.
motion: Mostly 1-frame pops and hard cuts; red lines and paths drawn on over 4-13 f; red scribble strikes over 5 f; red captions typed letter by letter; one ~200-f continuous sky drift (stars and a sun disc cross the frame above static travellers, ~30k px/frame steady); one ~110-f slow red spiral growth over a globe on black (~2.7k px/frame steady).
continuity: The three travellers keep the same silhouettes (turban, crown, hat) in every scene, inverted to white line art on the black night; the presenter and blackboard frame recur; JERUSALEM/BETHLEHEM dots keep their positions across the dashed-path states; added paths and labels persist until the next cut. Never reuse the quoted song-lyric captions.
